title: Unscripted: Are you measuring the right thing?
abstract:
Nathen Harvey led DORA research, which has spent a decade measuring how software teams deliver. Simon White comes at it from Theory of Constraints.

Two well-evidenced views, one question.

This is our unscripted stage. No slides, no script, and no idea where it ends up.

speakers.role_company: AI as an amplifier of software delivery
